info.description: Payment processing API for francophone West African businesses. Routes stay unversioned; OpenAPI info.version is the schema release. Send optional Lomi-Version to pin a known schema. Compatibility is additive: existing fields are not removed without a major info.version bump.

scopes.merchant.write: Write merchant resources (no payouts, refunds, or instant settlement)
scopes.merchant.money: Move money: payouts, refunds, and instant settlement

oauth2.description: Agent OAuth for MCP and Connect. Merchant REST still uses X-API-KEY by default.

merchant_lifetime_value.description: Predicted per-customer lifetime value (Customer Value x Avg Lifespan), org default currency

has_payout_pin.description: Whether a payout PIN is configured (not the PIN value)

is_starter_business.description: Whether this is a starter business

mrr.description: Monthly Recurring Revenue in default currency

arr.description: Annual Recurring Revenue in default currency

currency_code.description: Currency code for all monetary values

mrr.description: Monthly Recurring Revenue for the organization linked to the API key, in org default currency

arr.description: Annual Recurring Revenue (MRR × 12) for the organization linked to the API key, in org default currency

merchant_lifetime_value.description: Predicted per-customer lifetime value (Customer Value x Avg Lifespan) for the linked organization, in org default currency

mrr.description: Monthly Recurring Revenue for the organization linked to the API key, in org default currency

arr.description: Annual Recurring Revenue (MRR × 12) for the organization linked to the API key, in org default currency

price_id.description: Price ID used for this transaction

refunded_amount.description: Cumulative amount refunded to the customer across completed refunds on this transaction

is_bnpl.description: Whether this is a Buy Now Pay Later transaction

is_pos.description: Whether this is a POS (Point of Sale) transaction

updated_at.description: When the transaction was last updated

organization_id.description: Organization ID the customer belongs to

is_business.description: Whether the customer is a business

updated_at.description: When the customer was last updated

return_url.description: Merchant return URL shown in the portal header/footer

flow_after_completion_url.description: Redirect destination after successful completion of deep-link flow

price_id.description: Price ID used for this subscription

updated_at.description: When the subscription was last updated

transaction_id.description: UUID of a completed transaction (card, Wave, or MTN)

amount.description: Amount to refund (same currency as the transaction)

refund_type.description: Full or partial refund. If omitted, full when amount equals transaction gross amount.

subscription_action.description: Subscription side-effect after a full refund: default (cancel initial payment, pause renewal), cancel, pause, or none.

confirmation_token.description: Token from the preview response. Omit on the first call to receive a confirmation preview; send it on the second call to execute.

reverse_transfer.description: lomi. Network: on destination or separate charges, pull the proportional amount back from the Member Account transfer. Defaults to true.

refund_application_fee.description: lomi. Network: reverse the operator fee proportionally to the refund. Defaults to true. Set false to keep the operator fee on a refund.

message.example: Refund recorded. Customer credit is processed by our team.

subscription_action.description: Subscription side-effect applied after refund (if transaction was linked to a subscription).

currency_code.description: Currency of the transfer (XOF, USD, EUR). Balances settle in XOF.

destination.description: Member Account that receives the funds. Must be an active membership with the transfer.receive capability for this environment.

transfer_group.description: Transfer group linking this transfer to the payment(s) it settles (separate charges and transfers).

source_transaction_id.description: Transaction this transfer settles (optional, for reporting and refunds).

confirmation_token.description: Token from the preview response. Omit on the first call to receive a confirmation preview; send it on the second call to execute.

amount.description: Amount to reverse, in the transfer currency. Defaults to the remaining unreversed amount.

confirmation_token.description: Token from the preview response. Omit on the first call to receive a confirmation preview; send it on the second call to execute.

account.description: Member Account the embedded components are rendered for. Must be an active membership of your Network.

components.description: Components the session may render. Omitted components default to enabled.

amount.description: Price amount. For standard/tiered: fixed unit price. For pay_what_you_want: suggested unit price pre-filled at checkout.

minimum_amount.description: Lowest unit price the customer may pay (pay_what_you_want only).

maximum_amount.description: Optional upper bound on unit price (pay_what_you_want only).

is_default.description: Whether this is the default price

updated_at.description: When the price was last updated

failed_payment_action.description: Action to take on failed payment

updated_at.description: When the product was last updated

organization_id.description: Organization ID the coupon belongs to

discount_fixed_amount.description: Fixed discount amount (if discount_type is fixed)

customer_type.description: Customer type this coupon applies to

is_active.description: Whether the coupon is currently active

max_uses.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be used

current_uses.description: Current number of times this coupon has been used

applies_to_product_types.description: Product types this coupon applies to

updated_at.description: When the coupon was last updated

next_action.description: How the client should proceed when the session is still open

payout_id.description: Required for rail mode after a payout is created

confirmation_token.description: Token from the preview response. Omit on the first call to receive a confirmation preview; send it on the second call to execute.

event_type.description: Event type that triggered the webhook

response_body.description: Response body from the webhook endpoint

success.description: Whether the webhook delivery was successful

ip_address.description: IP address of the webhook endpoint

user_agent.description: User agent from the webhook response

headers.description: Request headers sent with the webhook

amount.description: Transaction amount in centimes (for SPI webhooks)

spi_event_code.description: SPI webhook event code (for SPI webhooks)

destination.description: Member Account that receives the funds (public account id). Must be an active membership of your Network with the transfer.receive capability granted for this environment.

amount.description: Amount to transfer to the destination, in the payment currency. Defaults to the payment amount minus application_fee_amount (and minus the lomi. processing fee when the member is the fees collector).

phoneNumber.description: E.164 phone number required for mobile-money rails

application_fee_amount.description: lomi. Network operator fee for this payment, in the payment currency. Overrides the membership fee rule. Requires a `Lomi-Account` header (direct charge) or `transfer_data` (destination charge).

transfer_data.description: lomi. Network destination charge. Only valid on an Operator API key without a `Lomi-Account` header.

transfer_group.description: lomi. Network transfer group. Links this payment to later transfers (`POST /transfers` with the same transfer_group) for separate charges and transfers.

type.description: How the client should proceed: open a URL, wait for webhook/status, or confirm with client_secret.

status.description: Present when type is await_webhook (e.g. PENDING, completed).

wave_launch_url.description: URL to open Wave so the customer can approve the payment.

data.description: Nested session data when returned by the edge function.

application_fee_amount.description: lomi. Network operator fee for this payment, in the payment currency. Overrides the membership fee rule. Requires a `Lomi-Account` header (direct charge) or `transfer_data` (destination charge).

transfer_data.description: lomi. Network destination charge. Only valid on an Operator API key without a `Lomi-Account` header.

transfer_group.description: lomi. Network transfer group. Links this payment to later transfers (`POST /transfers` with the same transfer_group) for separate charges and transfers.

status.description: Test keys return `completed` immediately; live returns `PENDING` until the customer approves.

transfer_data.description: lomi. Network destination charge. Only valid on an Operator API key without a `Lomi-Account` header.

transfer_group.description: lomi. Network transfer group. Links this payment to later transfers (`POST /transfers` with the same transfer_group) for separate charges and transfers.

amount.description: Amount to charge in the original currency

currency.description: Backward-compatible alias for currency_code. Use currency_code in new integrations.

customer_id.description: Internal customer UUID (v4). Alternative: send customer_email + customer_name to create/find a customer.

customer_email.description: Customer email, required together with customer_name when customer_id is omitted.

customer_name.description: Customer display name, required together with customer_email when customer_id is omitted.

description.description: Description shown in payment providers and logs

payment_reference.description: Reference included in metadata for reconciliation

product_id.description: Optional product UUID for metadata and reconciliation

subscription_id.description: Optional subscription UUID for metadata and reconciliation

metadata.description: Custom metadata merged into provider metadata

appearance_theme.description: Optional Payment Element theme for client-side card UI: `light`, `dark`, or `flat`.

appearance_border_radius.description: Optional Payment Element border radius (px) returned for client-side rendering.

appearance_billing_address.description: Optional Payment Element billing address collection mode. Use `never` to hide country/address selector in Payment Element UI.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Required unique key for money-moving writes. Replays return the original response.
